g.text: What a region loss costs you
The same event, in a two-zone and in a three-zone cluster. Time runs downward.
Red needs an operator, amber is impact you absorb, grey is a step that does not exist here.
every partition is down to 1 replica of 2
Disable the exporter to zone B
Snapshot and restore the secondary storage
zone B has no copy of the exported data
every partition still has 2 replicas of 3
only if the writer was in zone C
leaving the zone in place makes failback cheaper
there is one exporter, and one database
the database already holds the exported data
Processing is down until the first two are done.
